checkpoints.description: [1/3] Reject non-finite replay timeouts and validate clear request framing

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed --timeout inf crashes with OverflowError, and malformed Content-Length on POST /__clear silently wipes the inbox.
impact_assessment.benefits: Friendly CLI errors for bad timeouts and no destructive clear from malformed HTTP framing.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: malformed clear requests now get 400, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a rejected clear leaves the inbox untouched.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use math.isfinite plus an upper bound in argparse, catch OverflowError as a backstop, share the Content-Length validation, and add failing-first tests.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Working python -m entry point and safe clear on truncated bodies and corrupt inboxes

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed the documented python -m postbox.cli command is a silent no-op, a truncated clear body wipes the inbox, and CLI clear refuses the corrupt file it is meant to fix.
impact_assessment.benefits: Documented commands work, malformed clear requests are refused, and a corrupt inbox can be cleared from the CLI.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: added entry point and null count in JSON output, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a rejected clear leaves the file untouched.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add __main__.py, check the drained byte count before clearing, skip counting on corrupt files, and add failing-first tests for all three.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Read JSONL by newline only and reject blank pagination values

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed a header containing U+0085 makes every later read fail after a 200 capture, and ?limit= is silently ignored.
impact_assessment.benefits: Captures stay readable regardless of Unicode content, and malformed pagination gets 400.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: blank pagination now returns 400, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: existing valid files read identically.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Split only on \n, keep blank query values, and add failing-first tests for both.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Emit JSON top-level errors and report unmatched filters honestly

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed top-level errors print prose under --json, and a populated inbox filtered to no matches is falsely reported as empty.
impact_assessment.benefits: All CLI output is parseable in JSON mode, and empty-list messages are accurate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new JSON error kinds and a changed empty message, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Branch error printing on args.json, compare filtered against unfiltered counts, and add failing-first tests.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Drain clear bodies fully and validate chunked framing

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed a complete 16 MiB + 1 clear body is rejected and malformed chunked clear destroys the inbox.
impact_assessment.benefits: Large legitimate clear bodies succeed and malformed chunked bodies get 400 without data loss.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: chunked clear now validates, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a rejected clear leaves captures intact.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Drain Content-Length in bounded chunks, reuse the chunk decoder with no size cap, and add failing-first tests.
